title: ZHI World 3D Scene Data Catalog

source_of_truth.rule: Scene files describe spatial representation; they do not override authoritative agent state, movement, relationships, or world rules.

world_coordinates.name: zhi-world-coordinates
world_coordinates.notes: Must be read from authoritative ZHI world configuration before any conversion or 3D placement.

scene_local_coordinates.name: scene-local
scene_local_coordinates.notes: Local coordinates must never be treated as world coordinates without an explicit verified mapping.

scene_creation_policy_summary: Open-ended catalog: Mia may add new scene files on an authorized development branch. Unknown coordinates remain unverified; file creation does not imply runtime integration.
